name: Hosszúpereszteg (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and green in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hosszúpereszteg: a blue and yellow shield with hills, a castle wall and a wavy stripe, above a yellow scroll inscribed HOSSZÚPERESZTEG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
